title: AgentUX Protocol v1 enrollment
description: How a node joins one Command server: the server's identity (GET /v1/instance), the token an operator issues, its redemption (POST /v1/enroll) and the node credential it yields. See the README's Enrollment and sessions section. Fields added later in v1 are ignored by readers that do not know them.

instanceId.description: A Command server's identity, created once and kept for its database's life.

enrollmentToken.description: Single use, expiring, issued by one Command server, which it names. Shown once; servers keep only a hash.

nodeCredential.description: The node's own secret at the server that enrolled it, bound to its node id and organization. Returned once, by the redemption; never in any other answer, event or log.

nodeId.description: Unique on its Command server: a suffix is added when a host name is taken, never someone else's id.

instance.description: GET /v1/instance: who this server is. Unauthenticated; carries no tenant data.

redemption.description: POST /v1/enroll request. nodeName and hostname may be null or absent.

enrolled.description: POST /v1/enroll answer (200). approved is false while an operator still has to approve the node.

refused.description: A refused redemption: 401 (unknown, used or expired token) or 409 (a token of another Command server, with this server's instanceId; or a node name already enrolled).
